mapper.insert: INSERT INTO summary_metric_snapshot ( tenant_id, scope_type, metric_code, metric_payload, freshness, partial, failed_reason, as_of, created_at, updated_at, version ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{scopeType}, #{metricCode}, CAST(#{metricPayload} AS jsonb), #{freshness}, #{partial}, #{failedReason}, #{asOf}, now(), now(), 0 ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, scope_type, metric_code) DO UPDATE SET metric_payload = EXCLUDED.metric_payload, freshness = EXCLUDED.freshness, partial = EXCLUDED.partial, failed_reason = EXCLUDED.failed_reason, as_of = EXCLUDED.as_of, updated_at = now(), version = summary_metric_snapshot.version + 1
